focal_response.eligible_unit: Stage0 sampled plot-period with sampled=1, effort>0, qcflag=1
focal_response.binary_rule: 1 if one or more response rows have exact species=DM at same positive period and plot, else 0
focal_response.duplicate_or_recapture_rows: collapse to binary presence; never count abundance

temporal_protocol.first_calibration_period: initializes source set and is not used as a prediction-training row
temporal_protocol.forecast_semantics: for period t, construct Layer A/B using only positives from periods < t; after scoring/observing t, update state before t+1

worlds.distance: Euclidean metres between frozen plot centroids
worlds.compatibility_rule: a surviving local world is eliminated when a newly observed positive plot has zero support from every previously observed positive source plot under that threshold; external_open is never eliminated
worlds.support_rule: binary source-to-node reachability within threshold; external_open support=1 for every source-node pair

contextual_representation.source_ids: all distinct previously positive plots, equal source weighting

primary.metric: macro binary log loss across heldout census periods

secondary: number of heldout periods won by augmented arm

interpretive_boundary.known_truth_translation_supported_only_i: the predeclared contextual augmented arm has lower primary macro heldout log loss than the unchanged baseline
interpretive_boundary.adverse_result_means: known-truth mechanism safeguards did not translate into predictive added value in this fresh real system under the frozen interface
